summary_en: EDION executed an ASR (Accelerated Share Repurchase) block trade to acquire treasury stock worth 5.0 billion yen through ToSTNeT-3 on a date between November 10–16, 2026, at the closing price of the trading day between November 9–13, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Treasury Stock Acquisition through Off-Session Trading (ToSTNeT-3) (Treasury Stock Acquisition through Accelerated Share Repurchase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, EDION's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock through an Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) transaction with Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities. Under this structure, EDION will acquire treasury stock worth 5.0 billion yen through an off-session trade (ToSTNeT-3) by issuing warrant instruments to Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities. The acquisition is scheduled to occur on any trading day between November 10–16, 2026, at the closing price on any trading day between November 9–13, 2026. The actual number of shares and final acquisition price remain to be determined and will be disclosed after execution.

The company selected the ASR method to ensure reliable and prompt execution of the 5.0 billion yen repurchase, as standard market methods would require an extended period given EDION's trading volumes. Through ASR, Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities commits to supplying the full target amount by borrowing shares if necessary, guaranteeing execution within a single trading day. This approach supports the company's objective of improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation while returning value to shareholders.

As of September 30, 2026, EDION held 6,174,567 treasury shares and had 105,831,069 shares outstanding excluding treasury shares. Final details regarding execution date, purchase price, and number of shares acquired will be disclosed promptly following completion of the transaction.
